title: Approval policy
description: The Charter's approval rules as data. Each mandate says, for one action in one scope, whether an agent may act on its own (open) or needs a human to approve the specific action (closed). Shaped after AP2 v0.2.0 mandates: a versioned type, and a list of typed constraints that must all hold. Anything no mandate covers is denied, and prohibitions win over mandates.

policy.description: The policy's name, in kebab-case. Matches its ruleset directory.

extends.description: A policy this one adds to, as a path from the repo root or an https URL. Its actions, prohibitions and mandates apply too.

actions.description: Actions this policy adds to the permission vocabulary in agents-hive's execution-contract schema. Product actions are namespaced, e.g. lineup.event.cancel.

gated.description: True when the action is consequential, irreversible or externally visible, like the Charter's gated permissions.

prohibitions.description: Actions that are denied whatever any mandate says, even with a human's approval. A prohibition applies when its constraints hold and its unless conditions don't all hold.

action.description: A permission from agents-hive's execution-contract schema, or an action declared in actions.

type.description: open: the agent may act without asking while every constraint holds (AP2's open mandate). closed: a human approves the specific action before it runs (AP2's closed mandate).

present.description: Closed mandates only: what the approval request must show the human, like AP2's mandate content on a trusted surface.

exception.description: Required when an open mandate covers a gated action: why the Charter's approval rule is relaxed here, and where that was decided.

constraints.description: Typed constraints that must all hold, like AP2's constraints array. A fact the request doesn't supply never holds.

scope.description: Where the action applies: each named dimension of the request must be one of the listed values.

trigger.description: The action must be a response to one of these events.

condition.description: A fact about the request must equal a value, or be one of several.
